name: find_cocktails_by_ingredient
description: Find cocktails that use a given ingredient. Use when the guest says what they have on hand (e.g. "I've got gin" or "what can I make with rum?"). Returns a short list of drink names and ids; call get_cocktail_details for a full recipe.

ingredient.description: A single spirit or ingredient name, e.g. "Gin", "Rum", "Tequila", "Lime".
